harness.name: Ars0n Framework v2
harness.description: Bug bounty recon framework whose MCP server exposes data and scans to AI assistants.

uses.quote: The results of each tool are stored in a central database and can be used for understanding/visualizing the target company's attack surface.
The framework ships with a **Model Context Protocol (MCP) server** that exposes its data and scan controls to AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP-capable clients).
